week.title: Moments from a week of building, growing and gathering.
week.summary: A music gathering is taking shape, digital tools are becoming more useful, and the mountain garden continues to teach us.

highlights.title: Raíz Sonora
highlights.text: Bringing music, community and nature together through a new gathering.

highlights.title: Mágico Bookings
highlights.text: Making it easier for places of connection to welcome people.

highlights.title: Pueblo Mágico
highlights.text: Connecting hospitality, creative experiences and regenerative living.

highlights.title: Mountain garden
highlights.text: Observing, planting and learning from the land in Los Gigantes.

week.reflection: Different worlds, one thread: creating the conditions for people, ideas and places to flourish.

projects.name: Pueblo Mágico
projects.subtitle: A living mountain-based hospitality, culture and regeneration project.
projects.summary: A mountain retreat and community project combining regenerative hospitality, cultural events, land stewardship and digital operating systems.
projects.contribution: Product and systems strategy, AI-assisted digital engineering, project coordination and agroforestry fieldwork.

roadmap.title: Public website and guest communication
roadmap.detail: Guest-facing public website, event and booking inquiries are available.

roadmap.title: Integrated operational systems
roadmap.detail: Connect stock, reservations, commerce and team workflows into clear processes.

roadmap.title: Validated operational adoption
roadmap.detail: Measure team usage, booking outcomes, cost reduction and guest experience.

projects.imageAlt: Mountain landscape and green hills at golden hour
projects.vision: Create a welcoming mountain place where hospitality, culture and regeneration reinforce one another.
projects.evidence: Public website and guest inquiry flows are live; garden fieldwork and operational integrations are documented.
projects.impact: A tangible setting for collaboration and nature-connected experiences. Adoption, revenue and ecological results still need ongoing measurement.

projects.name: Mágico OS
projects.subtitle: Modular software infrastructure for organizations with real-world operations.
projects.summary: An emerging ecosystem connecting bookings, commerce, identity and operational tasks while preserving each module's source of truth.
projects.contribution: Cross-product strategy, system boundaries, integration decisions, technical backlog and AI-assisted implementation.

roadmap.title: Map core products and interfaces
roadmap.detail: Define Mágico Auth, Bookings, Commerce, shared UI and operational assistant boundaries.

roadmap.title: Develop reusable product foundations
roadmap.detail: Shared authentication, cross-platform components, service integrations and modular deployment.

roadmap.title: Pilot a separate organization installation
roadmap.detail: Validate data isolation, secure onboarding, operational use and support model.

roadmap.title: Validate external commercial offering
roadmap.detail: Package pricing, customer support and repeatable deployments only after real pilot learning.

projects.imageAlt: Digital collaboration and technology on a work desk
projects.vision: Make operational software more accessible for small, purpose-driven organizations.
projects.evidence: Architecture and shared components exist across reservations, commerce, identity and operations; deployment work remains in progress.
projects.impact: A foundation for less fragmented work. A repeatable external installation and measurable user benefit still need validation.

projects.name: Mágico Bookings
projects.subtitle: A configurable reservation platform for stays, experiences and retreats.
projects.summary: A bookings solution designed to support multiple organizations with secure configuration, reservations, inventory and payments.
projects.contribution: Reservation architecture, acceptance criteria, system integration and commercialization planning.

roadmap.title: Reservation domain and test foundation
roadmap.detail: Core reservation model and extensive test work documented in the engineering project.

roadmap.title: Independent deployment and organization setup
roadmap.detail: Configure onboarding, branding and data isolation; complete production and payment acceptance.

roadmap.title: External pilot validation
roadmap.detail: Run a real organization pilot and verify secure transactions and operations.

roadmap.title: Product package and supported release
roadmap.detail: Document installation, upgrade and customer support processes.

projects.vision: Help hospitality and retreat teams welcome guests without unnecessary coordination friction.
projects.evidence: Reservation functionality and tests have advanced; production approval and external tenant testing remain open.
projects.impact: Could reduce manual booking work. No external paid adoption is claimed.

projects.name: Raíz Sonora
projects.subtitle: A music and nature gathering in the Sierras Grandes, October 31, 2026.
projects.summary: A live festival campaign and guest journey bringing together music, nature, community and regenerative hospitality.
projects.contribution: Production coordination, communications, digital launch and music within the organizing team.

roadmap.title: Festival landing and reservation inquiries
roadmap.detail: Published artist information, access options and WhatsApp reservation pathways.

roadmap.title: Confirm paid bookings and prepare operations
roadmap.detail: Track inquiries, confirmed payments and onsite readiness ahead of the event.

roadmap.title: Deliver festival and document outcomes
roadmap.detail: Measure attendance, revenue, guest feedback and ecological contributions after October 31.

projects.imageAlt: Live music event and shared experience
projects.vision: Bring people together through music and nature in the Sierras Grandes.
projects.evidence: Festival landing page, program information and WhatsApp inquiry pathways were published ahead of the October 31 event.
projects.impact: Creates a real invitation to gather. Attendance and financial outcomes should be documented after the event.

projects.name: Huerta & Food Forest
projects.subtitle: Cultivating resilient mountain food systems with field evidence and digital documentation.
projects.summary: A living food-production and agroforestry initiative bringing together garden design, propagation, observation and traceable records.
projects.contribution: Growing, mapping, documenting, crop planning and integration with task and data systems.

roadmap.title: Garden planning and sowing system
roadmap.detail: Initial bed mapping, protected propagation and direct sowing documented.

roadmap.title: Field audit and mapping validation
roadmap.detail: Reconcile photographic evidence, plant records and actual bed placement.

roadmap.title: Seasonal harvest and ecological metrics
roadmap.detail: Track yields, soil health, water inputs and crop outcomes against the original plan.

projects.imageAlt: Green plants growing in fertile soil
projects.vision: Learn from the land while building a resilient mountain food system.
projects.evidence: Planting maps, propagation work and an audit of 54 photo/video records provide traceable evidence.
projects.impact: Supports better field decisions; harvest, water and soil indicators remain to be collected.

projects.name: Earth Bridge Alliance
projects.subtitle: Supporting community-led regenerative initiatives across cultures.
projects.summary: An emerging nonprofit structure to support place-based regeneration and cross-cultural project partnerships.
projects.contribution: Organization development, documentation, strategy and partnership coordination.

roadmap.title: Define purpose and organizational documents
roadmap.detail: Founding strategy and organizational documentation prepared.

roadmap.title: Complete administrative setup and partnerships
roadmap.detail: Registration and partner coordination require verification before representing them as complete.

roadmap.title: Launch a documented pilot collaboration
roadmap.detail: Publish transparent project goals, milestones and measurable outcomes.

projects.vision: Build enduring bridges between communities and regenerative initiatives.
projects.evidence: Founding documents and organizational framework have been prepared; administrative progress requires verification.
projects.impact: A potential structure for accountable cross-cultural collaboration, pending demonstrated pilots.

projects.name: Living Practices
projects.subtitle: Medicine music, ceremonial artifacts, sharing circles and conscious integration.
projects.summary: Human-centered creative practices exploring expression, connection and conscious development.
projects.contribution: Music, instrument crafting, circles and integration-oriented coaching.

roadmap.title: Develop the core practice
roadmap.detail: Medicine music, ceremonial crafting and facilitated connection are established areas of work.

roadmap.title: Document public offerings
roadmap.detail: Clarify practical formats, audience, boundaries and contact routes.

roadmap.title: Publish selected sessions and stories
roadmap.detail: Share examples and reflections with consent and appropriate care.

projects.imageAlt: Music as an expression of human connection
projects.vision: Create room for creativity, listening, personal exploration and shared presence.
projects.evidence: Medicine music, ceremonial instrument making and circle facilitation form an ongoing personal practice.
projects.impact: Impact is mainly qualitative; future stories should respect participant privacy and consent.

journal.title: From systems development to commercial launches
journal.description: Festival campaign launched, reservation product advanced and regenerative field evidence audited.
journal.outcome: Website deployed; production adoption and revenue still to verify.
journal.reflection: What does it take to bring an idea off the screen and into a real gathering?

journal.title: Designing products that can travel
journal.description: Supplier finance, cross-platform component libraries and an agricultural data foundation.
journal.outcome: Engineering milestones completed; external customer validation pending.
journal.reflection: Can a tool built for one community become useful to another without losing its human purpose?

journal.title: Laying the foundations for Mágico OS
journal.description: Reservation workflows, an AI operational assistant and shared platform architecture.
journal.outcome: Technical foundations advanced; real-world pilot adoption next.
journal.reflection: A good system doesn't replace relationships. It creates space for them.
